d: Vastu ev seva kar- jiesti kya hai aur isse bharat men taiks system men kaise badlav aaega | In this volume of the discussion on Goods and Service Tax (GST) aimed at civil services aspirants and for general knowledge of anybody watching the video interested in developments on Indian economy, Dr. Vikas Divyakirti (Drishti IAS faculty, MD) discusses the concept of GST in India. Note that this seminar was shot on 2 July 2017; please update yourself with all changes on GST after that date and use this video for a clear understanding of the concept (GST, CGST, IGST, SGST).
